title: Le Serpent de Pigalle (Attaque)
genre: Dark Cinematic French Trap (Captaine Roshi Type Beat)

structure.notes: Tension cinematographique E Phrygian : synth filtre LPF + motif Pluck + riser M4.
Drop initial conquerant : Kick + Snare/Clap sur 3 + Hats triolets + 808 V12 agressive + Pluck Lead + Vox Choir en appel-reponse.
Espace degage 800Hz-2.5kHz (M13-20 epure avec 808 Pluggg bounce, M21-28 reprise hats + perc ghosts + pivot mute/riser M28).
Coupure Kick/808 percussive, sub tenue + Vox Choir sombre + Bell cristalline + snare build & riser M32.
Retour massif : 808 V12 avec sauts d'octave + glissandos, doubles hats triolets, Pluck Lead + Bell + Vox Choir + Chant FX.
Variation rythmique (M41-48 syncopes 808 + open hats ; M49-56 montee progressive avec Bell + mute & riser M56).
Energie maximale : couche haute sur Bell/Pluck, 808 active, crash downbeat, chants et rolls 1/32.
Soustraction Kick/808 a M65, extinction progressive sur Synth filtre et echo Bell.

frequency_plan.sub_20_60: Mono strict (gl.stereo Width=0) reserve a BUS 808 (E1 41.2Hz - D2 73.4Hz), HPF 28 Hz, low-shelf +2.2 dB @ 52 Hz, coupe -3.2 dB @ 125 Hz.
frequency_plan.bass_60_250: Kick sidechain -> BUS 808 (attack 2ms, release 70ms) ; HPF >= 165 Hz sur BUS Music et Dark Piano.
frequency_plan.low_mids_250_500: Corps Dark Piano & Snare controles, coupe douce -2.5 dB @ 280 Hz sur Dark Piano.
frequency_plan.mids_500_4000: Relais Call-and-Response Lead Guitar vs Vox Choir (overlap <= 15%), creux -2.5 dB @ 1.8 kHz sur Dark Piano et -6 dB @ 635 Hz sur BUS Music.
frequency_plan.highs_4000_20000: Hi-hats triolets > 4 kHz (notch -5.5 dB @ 6.4 kHz + Air shelf @ 10.5 kHz), Counter Guitar/Bell shimmer, send unique FX Room (RT60=0.22s, Dry=0).
